annotations.title: Would this cron fire at a datetime?

description: Use when you need a yes/no on whether a cron expression would fire at a specific instant in a timezone — for example before shipping a schedule that crosses a DST transition, or to verify a single expected fire. Example: {"expression":"0 9 * * 1-5","timezone":"America/New_York","at":"2026-11-06T14:00:00Z"}. Returns fires true/false, the local wall time of that instant, and DST notes if the local time is in a gap or fold.

expression.description: Cron expression (5 or 6 fields, or a nickname like @hourly).
